Subject: Introducing the Beacon: 400 lumens, 40 hours, 95 grams
Preview: A headlamp built for the long haul — now available at Northbay Supply.
Body: You know the feeling: three miles from the trailhead at dusk, headlamp already dimming. The Beacon is built around that moment.

400 lumens lights up a lot of trail. 40 hours of runtime means a long weekend without rationing. At 95 grams, you'll stop noticing it's on your head. USB-C charging means one cable does the work — no proprietary adapters, no AA batteries to track down before a trip.

A note on waterproofing: we've seen the campaign brief, and we want to be straight with you. Our catalog does not currently list a water-resistance rating for the Beacon. We won't borrow a spec from our jackets and apply it here — that wouldn't be honest, and you deserve accurate information before you head out. Check the full product page for the confirmed IP rating before any serious rain or river crossing is on your itinerary.

What it is: a reliable, lightweight, rechargeable headlamp for backpacking, camping, and predawn starts.
What it isn't: rated for submersion or whitewater use based on currently available specs.

Shop the Beacon and see the full verified specs below.
